description:
Research any company and the people who work there, without leaving ChatGPT.

Look up a company by its website to see what it does, who it sells to and how, its tech stack (more than 3,000 technologies tracked, each with how and when it was detected), its email format and general inboxes such as sales@ and support@, address and phone where listed, recent tool changes and similar companies.

Find people at a company or in a role, with their job titles and LinkedIn profiles, taken from the company's own team and about pages.

Build prospect lists by technology, industry, business model, or B2B and B2C, for example B2B software companies that use HubSpot, and see which companies recently started or stopped using a tool.

Useful for account research before a sales call, building target lists and understanding a competitor's customers.

About 9 million companies are fully profiled, and any other company website is profiled on request, usually within a few minutes. AgentData only reads data: it never sends messages or changes anything.

Data comes from public web pages, DNS records and HTTP headers. Our crawler respects robots.txt and identifies itself. Anyone can ask for their data to be removed at agentdata.run/legal/data-removal.

defaultPrompt: Brief me on stripe.com before my call: what they do, who they sell to and how to reach them
Find 10 B2B SaaS companies that use HubSpot, with their domains
Who works in product at stripe.com?
